metadata.description: Claude and Codex skills for Swift packages, Apple frameworks, SwiftUI and UIKit, developer tooling, documentation, and release engineering

plugins.name: swiftpm-docs
plugins.description: Scaffold, audit, normalize, and export repository-native documentation architecture for Swift Package repositories

plugins.name: swiftpm-readme-design

plugins.name: swiftpm-architecture

plugins.name: swiftpm-plugin-patterns

plugins.name: swift-code-taste
